[P] | ABOUT SPDY : — Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude.

[Source: https://spyd.vercel.app/]

[P] | ABOUT SPDY : — In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement.

[P] The Techfest at the Academy of Technology — The Techfest at the Academy of Technology is an annual event that showcases innovation and creativity in various fields of technology. It features a range of activities including workshops, competitions, exhibitions, and lectures from industry experts. Students have the opportunity to display their projects, engage in hands-on learning, and network with professionals. This event aims to inspire and cultivate a passion for technology among attendees, fostering an environment of learning and collaboration.

[Source: https://spyd.vercel.app/highlights]

[P] Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology — Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology is an annual gathering focused on gaming and e-sports. It features competitive gaming tournaments, casual gaming sessions, and interactive workshops. Participants can compete in popular games, learn about game development, and connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts. The event aims to promote the gaming culture within the academy, encouraging both fun and educational experiences in the world of video games.

[Source: https://spyd.vercel.app/highlights]

[P] The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology — The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology is a prestigious gathering that highlights the contributions of women in the field of space engineering. Esteemed IIT professors and renowned female scientists from ISRO come together to share their experiences, insights, and advancements in space technology. The event includes inspiring talks, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, aiming to encourage and empower female students to pursue careers in space engineering and related fields.

[Source: https://spyd.vercel.app/highlights]

[P] The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology — The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology is a monthly gathering hosted by the Google Developer Group. It features tech talks, coding sessions, and networking opportunities for developers to share knowledge and collaborate on projects.
